title: Travel and Expense Policy
text: This policy applies to every employee and contractor who travels on company business.

children.title: Booking travel
children.text: Book flights, trains and hotels through the travel portal so that duty-of-care alerts reach you.

children.title: Flights
children.text: Economy class is standard. Business class is allowed for flights longer than six hours with approval from your director.

children.title: Trains
children.text: First-class rail tickets are allowed when the journey is longer than two hours and the fare difference is below 30 percent.

children.title: Hotels
children.text: Hotel rates are capped at 180 euros per night in Europe and 250 dollars per night in North America, breakfast included.

children.title: Expenses
children.text: Expenses must be necessary, reasonable and supported by itemised receipts.

children.title: Meals
children.text: The daily meal allowance is 60 euros. Alcohol is not reimbursed unless a client is present.

children.title: Submitting receipts
children.text: Upload receipts to the expense tool within 14 days of returning. Claims submitted later than 60 days are rejected.

children.title: Lost receipts
children.text: A lost receipt can be replaced by a signed missing-receipt declaration for amounts up to 50 euros.

children.title: Safety
children.text: Register every trip in the travel portal before departure.

children.title: High-risk destinations
children.text: Travel to high-risk destinations requires a security briefing and approval from the chief security officer.

children.title: Emergencies
children.text: In an emergency call the 24-hour assistance line printed on your travel card; costs are covered by the company.
